description: This Java test class verifies the behavior of ImmutableSearchResultBuilder, including creation, modification, and validation of SearchResult objects, especially handling null inputs and modifying search result properties.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchResultBuilderTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of ImmutableSearchResultBuilder, covering creation, copying, modification, and null input handling in building SearchResult objects.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test fixture before each test method.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewInstanceWithNullSearchResult
methods.description: Tests that passing null to the static 'of' method results in a NullPointerException.

methods.name: copySearchResultWithBuilder
methods.description: Tests copying an existing SearchResult and verifying equality.

methods.name: copyAndModifyExistingSearchResultWithBuilder
methods.description: Tests copying an existing SearchResult and modifying its properties, such as the next page offset.

methods.name: createEmptySearchResult
methods.description: Verifies that a builder with no modifications produces an empty SearchResult.

methods.name: tryToAddNullItem
methods.description: Ensures adding null item throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToRemoveNullItem
methods.description: Ensures removing null item throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addThingItem
methods.description: Tests adding a JSON item representing a 'Thing' to the SearchResult.

methods.name: addAndRemoveThingItem
methods.description: Tests adding and subsequently removing the same item, verifying the result is empty.

methods.name: setNextPageOffset
methods.description: Sets the next page offset and verifies it.

methods.name: tryToAddAllNull
methods.description: Verifies that adding null collection with addAll throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addItemsWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests adding multiple items via addAll and verifies contents.
